import numpy as np


def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("Invalid threshold: boolean values are not allowed")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("Invalid threshold: must be finite nonnegative")
    
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result), ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only), ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} cannot be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    
    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = raw_weights.sum()
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum if weight_sum > 0 else np.zeros(horizon)

    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)
    
    margins = L_minus - loss_plus
    keep = margins >= tau_filter
    
    return keep, margins"}

    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("Invalid threshold: boolean values are not allowed")

        raise ValueError("Invalid threshold: must be finite nonnegative")
    
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result), ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only), ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} cannot be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    
    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = raw_weights.sum()
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / weight_sum if weight_sum > 0 else np.zeros(horizon)
    
    # Compute weighted losses: -sum(weights * logp)
    loss_plus = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    loss_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    loss_no_call = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    
    # L_minus = min(L_empty, L_call_only)
    L_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)
    
    margins = L_minus - loss_plus
